latency.title: Delay between musicians
latency.mine: Your connection: {{rtt}} ms to the server, {{buffer}} ms buffer, {{output}} ms sound system.
latency.nobody: Nobody else has switched on Music mode yet. The delay to a person shows here as soon as they do.
latency.both_ways: to them {{to}} ms · from them {{from}} ms
latency.hint: An estimate from the measurements of both computers. Up to about 30 ms you can play together, up to about 60 ms slow pieces work, above that take turns and play to the click. A cable instead of Wi-Fi and headphones instead of speakers help most.

metronome.title: Metronome

watch_together.description: Paste the link of a YouTube video. Everybody in the conference watches it at the same time, and you control it for everybody: play, pause, jump and speed.

dialog_permissions.title: Permissions of {{name}}
dialog_permissions.description: Here you can inspect the exact permissions and where they come from. A permission consists of a key and a value that maybe used all over the application. The permissions are grouped in layers, depending of the status of the participant there may be different layers. Layers at the top overwrite permissions defined at the bottom if with the same key. The default values are false.

audio.title: Audio
audio.music_mode_description: Raw stereo sound for instruments and singing: echo cancellation, noise suppression and automatic volume are switched off and the quality is higher. Turn your microphone off and on again after changing it.
audio.music_mode_hint: Wear headphones in music mode, otherwise the sound of the speakers goes back into the microphone as an echo.
audio.instrument_input_description: A second input, for example your piano or bass on the sound card. It is sent as a track of its own next to your voice. Then use the piano button in the bottom bar.
audio.instrument_monitor: Hear my instrument in my headphones
audio.instrument_monitor_description: Plays your instrument to you straight from the sound card, without the delay of the call. Use it only with headphones (with speakers it feeds back), and not if your sound card already monitors directly, or you will hear it twice.
audio.instrument_monitor_no_input: Choose the input of your sound card above first.
audio.instrument_monitor_playing: Playing to your headphones now (about {{delay}} ms delay). You do not have to send the instrument to the others to hear it.
audio.instrument_monitor_blocked: The browser waits for a click on the page before it plays sound. Click anywhere on this window.
audio.instrument_monitor_error: The input cannot be opened. Check that the sound card is connected, or choose it again.
audio.instrument_meter_silent: The input gives no signal. Play something, check the cable and the gain knob of the sound card.
audio.instrument_meter_ok: Signal is arriving ({{channels}} channel(s)). Remember to press the piano button in the bottom bar to send it.
audio.instrument_meter_failed: This input cannot be opened. Choose another one, or allow the microphone in the browser.
audio.test_description: We will loopback your current audio input and show the results here. This way, you can check what other participants actually receive.
audio.repeat_audio_description: Click the button below and say something. Click it again and we will replay what you just said.
audio.something_to_say_text: Strive is much better than other video conference systems
audio.permission_denied: Permission denied: Please allow the use of your microphone in your browser

webcam.title: Webcam
webcam.test_description: We will loopback your current webcam input over the server and show the results here. This way, you can check what other participants actually receive and you also get a taste of the actual delay.
webcam.permission_denied: Permission denied: Please allow the use of your webcam in your browser

talking_stick_modes.queue_description: Participants can enqueue. If it's a participants turn, he becomes the presenter until he returns the stick. If the queue is not empty, the next participant will automatically be selected.
talking_stick_modes.race_description: The first person to take the stick becomes the presenter. After he returns the stick, anyone can take it again.
talking_stick_modes.moderated_description: Participants can join a list. The moderators can select participants from the list who then become the presenter.
talking_stick_modes.speakerPassStick_description: Participants can join a list. The first participant becomes the presenter and can then choose the next one from the list.
